title: Standardized Documentation and Assessments for Polycythemia Vera: A Quality Improvement Initiative
official: STANDARDIZEd Documentation and Assessments for Polycythemia Vera (STANDARDIZE-PV): A Quality Improvement Initiative
summary: The purpose of this quality improvement initiative is to explore whether an electronic medical records-based templated progress note for polycythemia vera (PV) in addition to a standard-of-care pharmacist-collaborative ropeginterferon alfa-2b titration service is feasible, acceptable, and appropriate for clinicians who manage PV.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Hematologists and medical oncologists within the Mass General Brigham network sites who treat at least one patient with PV in their outpatient clinic.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Clinicians who do not have an outpatient hematology or medical oncology clinic within Mass General Brigham.
* Clinicians who do not utilize the EPIC electronic medical record (EMR) System as their method of patient progress note documentation.
